safeHtml:

Fun Facts[]

  • The Backcomma refers to a Punctuation Mark in Chinese that is used either as a pause of categorization of nouns or in a list of numbers, and this station is named after the fact that a beach nearby is shaped like a "Backcomma".

History[]

  • January 24 2017: This station completed construction.[2]

Banack Isle is one of the isles on West Metropolis Archipelago.

Transport[]

Maritime[]

  • Banack Isle Ferry Pier

Railway[]

While this island features a loop line that runs around the island, the railway does not have any stations or platforms. Passengers must bring their own minecart to ride this railway.

Teleportation Spawn[]

A teleportation spawn to and from Earn Island is set up at the east of the island.

  • Banack Isle Community Hall
  • Renovation Stadium
  • Banack Enjoyment Pool

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the permanent Down Direction Terminus of Egress Line.
  • Similar to Sand Martin Checkpoint, the Name of this station alludes to Banyan Bridge in Hong Kong.[3]
  • The station number of Origin Line for this station was 13-06. However, it has later been changed to 13-07 with the completion of Samenta Station.
  • The Turn Back Sidings of Egress Line is located to the south of this station. As a result, the track section to the south of this station is the first exposed section featuring four different lines in Nazca Railway, namely Origin Line, Egress Line, Fox Line and ARIES Line.[4]
  • Despite having a larger line number, the platform numbers for Egress Line is smaller than that for Origin Line as Egress Line has a lower platform height.

History[]

  • March 2 2020: This station began services.
  • July 14 2022: Due to the completion of Samenta Station, the Origin Line station number has changed from 13-06 to 13-07.[5]

Barode Cave Station is a station on Glacier Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Asylum. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 2914, Line 2914P, Line 2915, Line 2915P (Kam Fung Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is named after a fact that a corroded cave is situated to the east of this station.
  • This station and Arctic Sea Station are Sister Stations in terms of design.
  • This station is located at approximately one kilometer to the east of a Village, and a path has been constructed between this station and that village.
  • This station, alongside Lucky Pit Station and Key River Station, is one of the "anchor points" for Glacier Line climbing to Elevated level from the north. As a result, Side Platforms are used for this station.

History[]

  • December 5 2020: This station began services.
  • June 25 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[2]
  • July 16 2025: All existing exits are named.[3]

Route 2 passes above this island, and West Shoal Exit is located to the north of this island. To the south of this island, the Route 9 Bufly West artificial island also exists for the tunnel entrance. However, no roads exist on this island.

title: Basod Tunnel
safeHtml:
Basod Tunnel is the first underwater tunnel in Los Sengas and in NR Los Sengas Division.

Description[]

  • Number of Tubes: 4
  • Length: 730 m
  • Lines Served: West Ring Line, Luxter Line
  • Location: West Shoal Checkpoint - Bufly Island Station

Technical Information and Characteristics[]

  • This tunnel is the first underwater tunnel built in Season 1.
  • This tunnel is the first underwater tunnel with 4 Tubes in Los Sengas Division, as well as the First Underwater Tunnel in Los Sengas as a whole.
  • This tunnel is the first underwater tunnel used by West Ring Line and Luxter Line.
  • This tunnel is Named such because it passes through Basod Island.

Fun Facts[]

  • When Xofa Line was named Xofa Crescent, the Station Number of this station was 5C-02. However, as Xofa Crescent was renamed Xofa Line due to changes in development plans, the Station Number is now 5A-02.[3]
  • This Station is the second Station in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division in which the English Name of this station features Diacritic Marks, with the first Station being Calmé Station. In this station's case, the Cedilla is used.
  • Due to mountainous terrain between Silver Plateau Station and this station, several tunnels were built.[4]
  • The Design of this station resembles Season 1 Stations, in particular Katadelphia Station.[5]

History[]

  • July 8 2019: This Station began construction.
  • July 10 2019: This Station began services.
  • May 13 2021: Due to changes in development plans, Xofa Crescent is renamed Xofa Line, and the Station Number of Xofa Line has changed.

Beak Beach Station was a planned station on Eastcoast Line and Southern Loop. It would have been operated by Peckern Metro, and would have been located in Peckern Beak Beach. However, due to changes in development plans, this station was never built.

Fun Facts[]

  • While the plans for Eastcoast Line were scrapped, the section between this station and Stone Shoal Station became a part of the Peckern South-East Coast Line. The Station corresponding to this station on Peckern South-East Coast Line is Senriyama Station.

Beak Isle was one of the isles in West Metropolis Archipelago. At the time of its existence, it was located to the northeast of Bufly Island. However, due to the lack of usable land on Bufly Island, this isle, alongside Butterfly Head Isle and Pointdown Isle were reclaimed by Bufly Island's owner. As a result, no trace of this isle's existence is found.

Beam Island is one of the islands on West Metropolis Archipelago.

Contents

      • 2.7.1 Power Plant
  • 3 Citations and References

Location[]

Beam Island is located to the west of Hatace Island, the east of Middle Island, the south of Peanut Island and the north of Sanfo Island and Watloop Island.

Transport[]

Nazca Railway[]

  • Stadium Line, Stadow Line Beam Island Station

Nazca Ferry[]

  • Beam Island Pier

Roads[]

  • San-Beam Highway

Points of Interest[]

Roads[]

The San-Beam Bridge provides land transport to and from Sanfo Island and enables residents on Beam Island to connect to Route 5 from there. Moreover, the bridge connecting to Peanut Island is currently under construction. Once that bridge is complete, it would connect to San-Beam Bridge.

Park[]

To the east of Beam Island is Beam Island Park, which has not undegone any development since this island began development. The park features a lake, a gazebo and a jogging trail.

Shopping Mall[]

A shopping mall is built at the reclamation grounds to the south. It features 50 shops and an outdoors coffee shop.

Power Plant[]

Beam Island's power plant is located at the east coast of Beam Island, on the opposite side of Beam Island Park. It features three sets of wind power generators and a set of solar panels.

History[]

  • June 22 2015: This station began services alongside Stadium Line.
  • May 19 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • January 13 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • May 21 2019: The Stadow Line part completed expansion.[6]
  • May 22 2019: Stadow Line extends from Peanut Island Station to this station.
  • November 4 2022: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[7]

Fun Facts[]

  • The design of this station, as well as the way platforms 3, 4 of this station are sealed off, are highly similar to that in Nazca Railway Squirrel Tail Station. However, while Platforms 3, 4 of Squirrel Tail Station are only seen from the VoxelMap mod, the existance of Platforms 3, 4 of this station are hinted in the elevator of this station. Hence, this station is seen as having 4 platforms in this wiki, whereas Squirrel Tail Station is seen as having only 2 platforms.
  • Due to underdevelopment in the vicinity, this station is not accessible from the ground level.
  • The station number of Evillow Line for this station was EV-20. However, it has later been changed to EV-22 due to Station Number rearrangements.

Bell Island Station is a station on Interisland Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Bell Island. Passengers may also use this station to change to Kirameki Electric Railway Citybranch Line (Bell Island Station) and Bell Island Light Railway Central Line, Skyring Line (Bell Pier Station).[2]

History[]

  • June 8 2017: This Station began services.
  • July 8 2018: This Station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]

Location[]

Belt Island is located to the west of Ponrest Island and the northeast of Bell Island. This island is developed in tandem with Frame Island, and with One Belt One Road, this island can connect to Elevate Island, Stoop Island, Inthree Island and Route 12.

Island Distribution[]

Belt Island has three islands in total, namely the main island, the Belt Island Hospital artificial island, and an unnamed shoal in the north.

Fun Facts[]

  • The Yellow and Green Terracotta used at this station, as well as the Delta Line Concourse shape, alludes to a corn, which in turn alludes to the Minecraft Name of the owner of Belt Island (CornHim).
  • While Arcgo Line originally had plans to serve this station, due to routing conflicts with the NFC, plans for this station to serve Arcgo Line are scrapped.

History[]

  • July 1 2016: This station began services alongside Delta Line.
  • June 10 2017: Interisland Line extends from Bell Island Station to this station.
  • June 26 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[7]
  • May 3 2020: Exits E, F are added to this station.[8]
  • September 27 2021: Exits F2, G are added to this station.[9]
  • December 4 2022: Exit H is added to this station.[10]
  • February 2 2025: The Station Banners of this station are set up.[11]

Belt Mall Station is a station on Line CB1 and Line CB3. It is operated by CornBelt Light Transit, and is located at Los Sengas Belt Island. Passengers may also use this station to go to the Delta Line Platforms of Belt Island Station for external access, as well as interchanging with NR Buses Route 54.[2]
